query: My landlord disconnected my electricity because I asked for a 2-day rent extension.
expected_bns_statute: Section 329 BNS 2023 r/w Sec 20 Model Tenancy Act
ground_truth_answer: Cutting essential utilities like electricity or water is illegal. Landlord faces action under Section 329 BNS, 2023 (Criminal Trespass) and Model Tenancy Act.

query: Landlord refuses to refund my ₹80,000 security deposit after 45 days of vacating.
ground_truth_answer: Under Model Tenancy Act and Section 318 BNS, 2023, security deposit must be refunded within 30 days after genuine agreed deductions.

query: Landlord gave an oral ultimatum to vacate in 24 hours.
expected_bns_statute: Model Tenancy Act / Rent Control Act
ground_truth_answer: A minimum 30 days formal written notice is statutory. Summary forced eviction is an offence under Section 329 BNS, 2023.

query: Landlord locked the front gate while I was at work.
ground_truth_answer: Illegal lockout constitutes wrongful restraint and criminal trespass under Section 329 BNS, 2023.

query: Broker took 1 month deposit and vanished with keys.
ground_truth_answer: Dishonest inducement and cheating punishable under Section 318 BNS, 2023.

query: Landlord entered my rented apartment without notice while I was away.
ground_truth_answer: Landlord requires 24-hour prior notice. Unauthorized entry is criminal trespass under Section 329 BNS, 2023.

query: Commercial shop owner doubled rent overnight without agreement clause.
ground_truth_answer: Arbitrary rent hikes violate agreed lease covenants and state rent control provisions.

query: Landlord took ₹1,50,000 advance cash and refuses to provide receipt.
ground_truth_answer: Issuance of rent and deposit receipts is mandatory under Section 13 Model Tenancy Act.

query: Tenant refusing to vacate after 11-month lease expired.
ground_truth_answer: Remedy lies through Rent Court under Model Tenancy Act, not physical self-help.

query: Subletting dispute in residential society.
ground_truth_answer: Regulated by tenancy contract clauses under Model Tenancy Act.

query: Lost ₹45,000 in fake APK electricity bill scam on UPI.
ground_truth_answer: Report immediately to 1930 and file Zero FIR under Section 173(1) BNSS, 2023 for cyber personation under Section 318(4) BNS, 2023.

query: SIM swap fraud resulted in ₹2 Lakh bank deduction.
ground_truth_answer: Zero-FIR under Section 173(1) BNSS, 2023 and identity theft complaint under Section 66C IT Act r/w BNS 2023.

query: Defrauded by online job work-from-home Telegram scam.
ground_truth_answer: Punishable under Section 318(4) BNS, 2023 with imprisonment up to 7 years.

query: Phishing email pretending to be income tax refund stole bank credentials.
ground_truth_answer: Forgery of electronic records under Section 336 BNS, 2023 and cheating under Section 318 BNS, 2023.

query: Blackmail via morphing photos on loan app.
ground_truth_answer: Criminal intimidation under Section 351 BNS, 2023 and cyber harassment under IT Act 2000.

query: Unauthorized ATM withdrawal cloned card in Mumbai.
ground_truth_answer: Theft under Section 303(2) BNS, 2023 and digital fraud under Section 318 BNS, 2023.

query: Fake customer care number scam for airline ticket refund.
ground_truth_answer: Impersonation and cheating under Section 318(4) BNS, 2023.

query: Investment crypto Ponzi scheme WhatsApp group stole ₹5 Lakhs.
ground_truth_answer: Organized economic offense under Section 111 BNS, 2023 and Section 318 BNS, 2023.

query: Fake KYC update call asked for OTP.
ground_truth_answer: Cheating by computer resource under Section 66D IT Act and Section 318 BNS, 2023.

query: Identity theft creating fake Instagram profile demanding money.
ground_truth_answer: Digital impersonation under Section 66C IT Act and Section 318 BNS, 2023.

query: Purchased smartphone online, received soap bar, seller refused refund.
ground_truth_answer: Unfair trade practice and deficiency of service under Section 35 CPA 2019 and Section 318 BNS, 2023.

query: Flight canceled by airline with zero refund provided.
ground_truth_answer: Deficiency in service under Consumer Protection Act 2019; eligible for full refund plus interest.

query: New refrigerator stopped cooling in 3 days, company refused warranty.
ground_truth_answer: Product liability and deficiency under CPA 2019; file complaint on e-Daakhil.

query: Hospital charged ₹50,000 above package rate without consent.
ground_truth_answer: Medical billing deficiency under Consumer Protection Act 2019.

query: Car dealer refused to fix recurring engine defect in new car.
ground_truth_answer: Manufacturing defect and replacement entitlement under Section 39 CPA 2019.

query: Online course promised 100% placement or money back, now ghosting.
ground_truth_answer: Misleading advertisement and unfair contract terms under CPA 2019.

query: Restaurant charged mandatory service charge after refusal.
ground_truth_answer: Violation of CCPA guidelines and unfair trade practice under CPA 2019.

query: Insurance claim denied on frivolous ground after premium paid for 5 years.
ground_truth_answer: Deficiency of insurance services under Consumer Protection Act 2019.

query: Real estate builder delayed flat possession by 3 years.
ground_truth_answer: Right to refund with statutory interest under Section 18 RERA 2016 and CPA 2019.

query: Adulterated food packet caused food poisoning.
ground_truth_answer: Product liability action against manufacturer under Section 84 CPA 2019.

query: Police officer refused to register FIR for stolen mobile phone.
ground_truth_answer: Under Section 173(1) BNSS, 2023, Zero FIR is mandatory. Citizen can petition SP under Section 173(4) BNSS, 2023.

query: Neighbor giving physical death threats over parking.
ground_truth_answer: Criminal intimidation punishable under Section 351(3) BNS, 2023 up to 7 years imprisonment.

query: Police did not provide free copy of FIR after registration.
ground_truth_answer: Statutory guarantee: Free copy of FIR must be given immediately under Section 173(2) BNSS, 2023.

query: Victim of physical assault seeking investigation status after 3 months.
ground_truth_answer: Mandatory progress update to victim within 90 days under Section 193(3)(ii) BNSS, 2023.

query: Minor theft of bicycle worth ₹3,500 by first-time offender.
ground_truth_answer: Theft under Section 303(2) BNS, 2023. Proviso enables community service for first-time offenders under ₹5,000.

query: Someone extorting money by threatening to post private messages.
ground_truth_answer: Extortion under Section 308 BNS, 2023 and criminal intimidation under Section 351 BNS, 2023.

query: Snatching handbag on motorcycle in public road.
ground_truth_answer: Snatching specifically codified under Section 304 BNS, 2023 with imprisonment up to 3 years.

query: Wrongful confinement in office room.
ground_truth_answer: Wrongful confinement punishable under Section 127 BNS, 2023.

query: Hit and run vehicle accident fleeing scene.
ground_truth_answer: Causing death by rash and negligent driving and escaping under Section 106(2) BNS, 2023.

query: Apprehending false arrest, seeking pre-arrest protection.
ground_truth_answer: Anticipatory bail petition under Section 482 BNSS, 2023 before Sessions or High Court.

query: Municipal corporation not disclosing tender details for road repair.
ground_truth_answer: File RTI under Section 6(1) of RTI Act, 2005 with ₹10 fee; response mandatory within 30 days.

query: Government department delayed RTI reply beyond 45 days.
ground_truth_answer: File First Appeal under Section 19(1) RTI Act, 2005 before First Appellate Authority.

query: Seeking emergency RTI regarding hospitalized family member.
ground_truth_answer: Under Section 7(1) RTI Act, information concerning life or liberty must be provided within 48 hours.

query: Employer terminated employee without notice or severance pay.
expected_bns_statute: Industrial Disputes Act & State Shops Act
ground_truth_answer: Illegal termination and severance recovery through Labour Commissioner.

query: Company withheld 3 months salary of software developer.
expected_bns_statute: Payment of Wages Act & Sec 318 BNS 2023
ground_truth_answer: Recovery under Payment of Wages Act and civil recovery notice.

query: Employer not depositing deducted PF amount into EPFO.
ground_truth_answer: Deducting PF and not depositing constitutes Criminal Breach of Trust under BNS, 2023 and EPF Act.

query: Hospital refusing patient discharge until arbitrary bill cleared.
ground_truth_answer: Detaining patient is unlawful confinement under Section 127 BNS, 2023.

query: Gram Panchayat sarpanch refusing to show MNREGA muster rolls.
ground_truth_answer: Social audit right and RTI disclosure under Section 6 RTI Act, 2005.

query: Female employee facing workplace sexual harassment.
ground_truth_answer: Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) remedy under POSH Act and Section 75 BNS, 2023.

query: Police refusing to accept e-FIR for theft.
ground_truth_answer: Electronic information (e-FIR) is expressly recognized under Section 173(1) BNSS, 2023.
